subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw expose and support a permanent `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` configuration and `AgentThinkingLevel` SDK contract even though it intentionally has no effect on native Codex app-server compaction?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically coherent and backward-compatible when unset, but repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration and compatibility-sensitive SDK surfaces; that product/API boundary cannot be selected from tests or proxy logs alone.

options.title: Sponsor the embedded-only setting
options.body: Accept the new optional public contract, retaining the native-Codex warning and the documentation that limits its scope to embedded OpenClaw compaction.

options.title: Keep session-level thinking only
options.body: Decline the additional configuration and SDK surface so compaction continues to inherit the session thinking level across supported runtimes.

options.title: Redesign around a broader runtime contract
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers define a cross-runtime compaction-thinking capability that native Codex can represent consistently.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the embedded-only setting
recommendation.body: Accept the new optional public contract, retaining the native-Codex warning and the documentation that limits its scope to embedded OpenClaw compaction.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned on the PR and is the clearest available reviewer for the pending public-contract decision.
